title: Epstein as the front for a project or special access program

tellings.quote: I don't think he was running the Jeffrey Epstein special access project or whatever it was.

plain: The idea is that the financier Jeffrey Epstein, with his private plane and island, was the public face of some kind of hidden project or special access program, the most tightly restricted kind of secret US government programme. A researcher named Eric Weinstein raises it in passing, without naming a source, while saying of another man that he does not think that man was the one running "the Jeffrey Epstein special access project or whatever it was." If true, it would mean Epstein's activities were part of something organised from above.
